messages:
emily-docs: Heads-up — we need to merge the docs PR that adds the SDK auth snippet and also fixes the broken link in the migration guide before the 2.8 cutoff. Target cutoff: Wed 2026-03-25 17:00 PT. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345 :hourglass:
sam-plt: I can review but not until tomorrow afternoon. Who else can give a quick look for API accuracy? :eyes:
maria-eng: I can do API correctness and snippet verification. Quick note — docs preview CI failed once for this branch (missing asset path). See logs in the job: CI job 4822.
dev-bot: deploy-preview ready: https://deploy-preview-2345--docs.redwood.ai/ — preview generated at 2026-03-21T14:03:10Z
andre-docs: I pushed a tiny wording change to the migration guide paragraph and fixed the anchor that was 404ing. Also updated the SDK snippet to include region config:
andre-docs: ```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY,
  region: 'us-west-2'
});
```
emily-docs: Nice. maria, can you confirm the snippet matches the client init in runtime? If it's correct, we'll aim to merge tomorrow and slot it into the post-cutover patch or include in the scheduled minor depending on feature-flag gating.
maria-eng: Confirmed — snippet matches the runtime API. Only caveat: if customers use dedicated/private deployments they may need to set baseUrl in addition to region. Maybe add a one-line note.
sam-plt: I can approve after the one-line note. If we merge after the cutoff, can we still ship the docs behind a feature flag or is that more risky?
jordan-sre: For code/docs only, we can publish docs any time. If the change references a feature-flagged runtime behavior that isn't live, add a note. For releases tied to binary changes, we should coordinate timings. :white_check_mark:
emily-docs: Good call. This change is docs-only + snippet update, no runtime diff, so safe to merge. Plan: sam to approve tomorrow, maria to double-check the dedicated/private note, then merge. Aim for merge by Tue 2026-03-24 18:00 PT to give release team time to include in cutover notes.
andre-docs: I'll add the dedicated/private note now.
emily-docs: Also quick ask — CI preview URL doesn't render the sidebar correctly for this branch (missing version selector). @dev-bot, any known preview caching issues?
dev-bot: Noted. Preview builder used cache layer v3. Rebuild triggered: https://deploy-preview-2345--docs.redwood.ai/?clear_cache=1
sam-plt: Re-queued my review for 24h from now. If everything is green I'll /approve and merge. If there's any blocker, ping me in this thread.
emily-docs: Thanks all. I'll monitor and update release notes if merged. :shipit:
andre-docs: Merged wording tweak and added dedicated/private note in latest commit. Waiting for CI to finish.
maria-eng: CI is green on my side; snippet linted. One suggestion: change `region` example to `region: process.env.REDWOOD_REGION || 'us-west-2'` to avoid hardcoding in examples.
andre-docs: Good point — updated to env fallback.
emily-docs: Final: sam please merge when you approve. If anything slips past cutoff, we'll coordinate a patch docs release. Last_message_ts: 2035004389
